summary: Solid, production-plausible design that cleanly separates strongly-consistent release pointers from highly-cacheable immutable payloads, enabling fast rollback and scalable distribution via CDN. The agent-side LKG + monotonic generation model and progressive rollout controls make failure containment credible, but the design leans heavily on in-service caching and operational discipline to hit the stated QPS/latency targets.
strengths: Clear pointer/payload split with immutable blobs, integrity checks, CDN caching, and fast pointer-based rollback
Safety mechanisms are well thought out (monotonic generations, LKG fallback, progressive rollout steps/gates, audit immutability)
weaknesses: Postgres + single combined Config Service is a scaling and blast-radius risk (150k QPS long-poll/resolve requires careful connection management, cache consistency, and DB protection beyond what’s specified)
Multi-region control-plane semantics are under-specified (write locality, conflict resolution, regional failover behavior, and security/key management for signing/rotation)
